name: Final re-measure before the 19 Nov 08:00 approval verdict — give the approver a current file list, not a 19-hour-old one
description:
## Why

The tree under approval (`a8be6182`, verdict due **19 Nov 08:00**) has already been re-baselined twice today: **5 authored files +174/−13** at 11:27 → **6 files +245/−13** at 12:52. The sixth (`features/browser-use.md`, modified +71, no owner) appeared *after* the approver had been told the list. Nothing prevents a seventh appearing overnight.

Every agent shift in this project runs against this same working tree. A file added between 12:52 and 08:00 tomorrow would be **silently absorbed** into what the approver signs — which is precisely how four unowned files became "reviewed" in the first place.

## What to do (15 minutes, before 07:15)

1. Run `project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD, include_patch=false)` and **filter to the non-`.codx` paths**. Do not quote a figure from a card — measure it.
2. Compare the result against the six paths listed on `a8be6182`. Classify each file as: **unchanged / grown / new**.
3. Append **one** comment to `a8be6182` — the final list, the timestamp you measured at, and nothing else that repeats what is already there.
   - If nothing changed: say so in one line. That is a valid, useful result and it lets the approver act on the existing list with confidence.
   - If a file is **new or grown**: name it, state that it is **not covered by the current baseline**, and give it its own line in the approve/hold table. Do not fold it into an aggregate.
4. Add a comment to `2410a44c` only if a new **unowned** file appeared — that card's scope is already amended for `features/browser-use.md` and must not silently absorb a sixth.
5. If the total authored file count has changed again, say in the comment that the pinned-list rule (recommended in `a8be6182`) is now the second time this has cost a re-baseline, and restate it in one sentence.

## Constraints

- **Read-only.** Do not commit, stage, revert or edit any repository file. The tree is the artefact under review; touching it invalidates the approval.
- Do not run `request_changes` / the engine on `a8be6182` — it is a human decision card awaiting a human. Use comment-only (`request_help`).
- Do not re-litigate the options A/B/C on `a8be6182`. The recommendation is unchanged (A + pinned list). This card exists only to make the inventory current at the moment of decision.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tree re-measured within the hour before 08:00, with the measurement timestamp stated.
- [ ] `a8be6182` carries the final per-file list before 08:00.
- [ ] Any new file named explicitly as not-covered, never merged into a count.
- [ ] No repository file modified, staged or reverted.

Owner profile: **ProjectManager** — this is schedule hygiene and reporting on a decision card, not documentation work or code.

Do the work, then follow the shift-end format: **Done / Scheduled / Blocked** with the measured figures as evidence.

**PM shift 2026-11-18 12:52 (5th) — baseline for your 07:15 run. Report DELTAS against these numbers, not absolutes.**

I measured the tree four times today and it changed every time. Absolute numbers are worthless to the approver; deltas are the finding. Use exactly this baseline (measured ~13:05 UTC, `project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD)`):

**Whole tree:** 44 files, +709 / −1978.

**Authored content — the only thing the approver should be signing (7 entries):**
| file | state at baseline |
|---|---|
| `delivery-contract.md` | M, +44 / −13 |
| `features/browser-use.md` | M, **+74 / −0** |
| `features/voice-conversation.md` | untracked, 157 lines |
| `qa/security-reviewer-attribution-spec.md` | A (staged), +128 |
| `.codx/.gitignore` | A (staged), +13 |
| `.vitepress/config.mts` | M, +1 |
| `features/index.md` | M, +1 |

**Everything else is `.codx` agent runtime churn — do not enumerate it to the approver.**

### Observed drift today (this is your headline)
- `features/browser-use.md`: **0 → +71 → +74** across three measurements in one shift.
- `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl`: **+349 → +364 → +382** in 90 minutes of a single shift.
Every card comment any agent files enlarges the diff being approved. That is the loop, and it is why the recommendation on `a8be6182` is *approve a pinned list at a stated time*, not "the working tree".

### What to do at 07:15 (15 minutes, read-only)
1. Re-run `project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD)`; output the same 7-row authored table plus a **Δ column** against the baseline above.
2. Flag any NEW authored file (anything outside `.codx/`, `.vitepress/`, `features/`, `qa/`, `delivery-contract.md`) as **not covered by the approval** — this is how the list grew from 5→6→7 entries today.
3. One line on whether the `.codx` runtime cleanup happened: if `.codx/autonomy/state.json` still shows `M`, then `82314f38` (wake 07:00, 15 min before you) **did not run**, and the approver must be told the tree will change again within the hour.
4. Comment the result on `a8be6182` with a `measured at HH:MM UTC` timestamp. **Do not approve, do not edit or commit any file, do not run the QA/CISO gates.** Then set your own status `done` and stop — `2410a44c` (19 Nov 12:00) and `f6d1855e` (21 Nov 08:30) carry the work forward.

Reference: `features/browser-use.md` and `features/voice-conversation.md` are both **reachable from live site nav** (`.vitepress/config.mts:50` / `features/index.md:32` for browser-use). `qa/security-reviewer-attribution-spec.md` is linked from **nowhere** — verified, 10/10 atlas hits inside the file itself — and is the safest single file in the change.

## Carry-forward for the 19 Nov 07:15 re-measure — do not wait for `2410a44c`

QA shift 5 (2026-11-18T13:31Z), measured constraint on this card's input:

- This card wakes **2026-11-19T07:15Z**, ahead of the **08:00Z** approval verdict — correct.
- But `2410a44c` (*Intake — four unowned files…*, owner `biblio`) wakes **2026-11-19T12:00Z**, i.e. **four hours after the approval it exists to inform**. Its own description says it must "report the verdict on `a8be6182`: keep these files in the approved tree, or exclude them". At 12:00 that decision has already been taken.
- `2410a44c` has since grown a **seventh** unowned item: `features/users-and-security.md` links the unowned, unreleased page `features/voice-conversation.md` from an **already-published** page, so reverting the two nav lines alone no longer removes it from the site graph.

**Therefore:** run this re-measure on the tree as it actually is at 07:15, and emit the unowned/unauthored file list yourself — do not gate the output on `biblio` reporting first. The minimum the approver needs, with the root and a timestamp on every count:

1. `project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD)` filtered to the non-`.codx` tree → the authored-file list (today: `delivery-contract.md` + `qa/security-reviewer-attribution-spec.md` + `features/voice-conversation.md` + `.vitepress/config.mts` + `features/index.md` + `features/users-and-security.md`).
2. For each one: owner + milestone, or the explicit words **"unowned — do not approve as reviewed"**.
3. `qa_plan()` with its root named (`.codx` counts and `changed_files` differ by root: 181 platform / 48 docs root / 42 `.codx`-at-platform measured on the same afternoon).

**Why this matters for QA:** the standing verdict on `a8be6182` is `require_approval` (unmapped sources, no suite). An approver who reads a 19-hour-old count, or a list that omits the unowned files, is approving something nobody measured. The verdict does not become `allow` by re-measuring — it becomes *defensible*.

No file was edited; `2410a44c` was **not** moved or re-armed by QA (owned by `biblio`).

**Schedule correction — `wake_at` moved 07:15Z → 07:40Z (QA shift 6, 2026-11-18T15:58Z).**

Measured, not assumed:
- `get_task(a27334a8).wake_at` was **2026-11-19T07:15Z**
- `get_task(2410a44c).wake_at` is **2026-11-19T07:20Z** (owner `biblio`)

This card was armed **five minutes before the card that feeds it**. The intake at 07:20 is what establishes provenance for the four unowned files (`qa/security-reviewer-attribution-spec.md`, `features/voice-conversation.md`, `.vitepress/config.mts`, `features/index.md`). A re-measure at 07:15 would therefore have posted them to `a8be6182` as *"unowned — do not approve as reviewed"*, and 07:20 would have contradicted that five minutes before the approver reads it. A self-contradicting final list is worse than the stale list this card exists to replace.

New window: **07:40Z**, i.e. after the 07:20Z intake and 20 minutes before the 08:00Z verdict.

**Two additions to the procedure, both to be applied at wake time:**

1. **Robust to an unfinished intake.** If `2410a44c` has not posted its provenance verdict by the time you measure, do **not** guess either way. Post the measured file list, and state explicitly: *"provenance still open on `2410a44c`; these four files are neither cleared nor rejected."* An open item is a valid result; a resolution invented by the timer is not.
2. **Record the ref with the timestamp.** Counts in this repo drift with root and with time — tonight's measurements are 189 files at the platform root, 53 at the docs root and 42 for `.codx`-at-platform, all on the same tree. Quote the timestamp **and** `git rev-parse --short HEAD` (read-only) with every figure, so a count can be reproduced instead of re-litigated.

**Not covered by this card:** `82314f38` (human `git rm -r --cached` on `.codx`) wakes 07:00Z and can rewrite the tree *between* 07:40 and 08:00. If the measurement shows `.codx` already untracked, say so in one line and note that the 08:00 decision is being taken on a tree that changed after the last baseline — do not silently reconcile it.

No repository file was read-modified, staged or reverted to write this note.

**Measurement recipe — the exact commands, because the obvious one is now known to lie (QA shift 6, 2026-11-18T16:20Z).**

Do **not** produce the approver's file list with `qa_review_changes(paths=[...])`. Measured this shift on this very tree: that filter resolves **tracked** entries at the repo root and **untracked** entries at the project root, and a path that matches nothing returns `allow / changed_files: 0 / highest_severity: none`. Both spellings can lie, in opposite directions:

| filter | verdict | changed_files | truth |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docs/delivery-contract.md` (tracked) | block | 1 | correct |
| `delivery-contract.md` | allow | 0 | **false green** |
| `features/voice-conversation.md` (untracked) | block | 1 | correct |
| `docs/features/voice-conversation.md` | allow | 0 | **false green** |
| `this/path/does/not/exist.py` | allow | 0 | **false green** |

### Use these instead (all exercised this shift)

1. `git rev-parse --short HEAD` — record it; every figure below is meaningless without it.
2. `project_changes(scope="all")` — the authoritative tree diff and file list. Measured **53 files, +924/−1978** at docs root, 15:57Z. Use this for the approver's list.
3. `qa_plan(scope="all")` — suite availability + mapping + which changed sources have no test. Measured **189 changed files** at platform root (different root, different number — that is expected, not a discrepancy).
4. `qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=True)` — the gate verdict. Never pass `run_tests=False`; with tests off a real `block / high / 1 finding` becomes `allow / none / 0 findings` on a byte-identical change.
5. `qa_coverage` — expect `no coverage report found`; report it as **unmeasured**, not as a pass.

### Three rules for what you write at 07:40Z

- **A `changed_files: 0` is never "nothing changed".** It means the filter matched nothing. If your run returns it on a path that visibly exists, say so explicitly rather than quoting it as clean.
- **Name the root and the timestamp** next to every count: `project_changes` (docs root) and `qa_plan` (platform root) legitimately differ by ~3×.
- **If `2410a44c` has not answered**, write *"provenance of the four unowned files still open"* — do not guess and do not silently drop them from the list.

Standing verdict on the tree is unchanged: **`require_approval`** (`a8be6182`). Your job is to hand the approver a *current* list, not to change that verdict.

## Baseline to compare against at 07:00Z (measured this shift, 16:05Z)

Woken 45 min earlier than planned (07:00 instead of 07:40) so the result is on `a8be6182` well before 08:00 and does not queue behind the 07:20 intake run.

The path list on `a8be6182` is already superseded — it has **7 authored entries**, not 6. Compare *figures*, not just names:

| file | measured 2026-11-18T16:05Z | classify as |
|---|---|---|
| `delivery-contract.md` | M +44/−13 (owned — M1 / decision C) | stable |
| `features/browser-use.md` | M +91/−0 (was +71 at 12:52Z) | **grown +20 today** |
| `features/voice-conversation.md` | untracked, **185 lines** (was 157 at 12:52Z) | **grown +28 today** |
| `qa/security-reviewer-attribution-spec.md` | A +128/−0 | stable |
| `.vitepress/config.mts` | M +1/−0 | stable |
| `features/index.md` | M +1/−0 | stable |
| `features/users-and-security.md` | M +2/−0 | stable |

Total ≈ **+452 / −13, 7 entries, 5 unowned.**

### Three instructions

1. **Re-measure, then answer one question: is any figure above different?** If nothing moved, one line on `a8be6182` ("unchanged since 16:05Z, sign that list") is the whole deliverable. Do not restate the table — the approver has it.
2. **Growth is the failure mode, not addition.** Both files that grew today grew *after* they were already in the baseline. So a same-count-but-different-size result is a drift and must be reported — an aggregate "+452" hides it.
3. **Do not edit, stage or revert anything**, and do not run the engine on `a8be6182`. It is a human decision awaiting a human.

If a writer shift touched either unowned page overnight, say so plainly and name it as **not covered by the 16:05Z list** — do not silently adopt the new text into what management signs.

## Executed at 08:26Z — measurement posted on `a8be6182`; the result is "everything changed"

This card's step 1–3 are done; the single comment it asked for is on `a8be6182` (comment posted 08:26Z, card not modified). This card was due 07:00Z and had not run, so the measurement was taken at 08:26Z — 26 minutes after the 08:00 verdict deadline, which is late but still before any signature.

**Validation evidence**
- `project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD, paths=["delivery-contract.md","qa"])` → **No changes found** ⇒ those two baseline items are committed.
- `project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD, paths=["delivery-contract.md","features","qa",".vitepress",".codx/.gitignore"])` → **7 files, +101/−0**: `.vitepress/config.mts (+2)`, `features/browser-use.md (+91)`, `features/chats-and-agents.md (+4)`, `features/index.md (+2)`, `features/users-and-security.md (+2)`, `? features/suggested-replies.md`, `? features/voice-conversation.md`.
- `repository_overview()` → branch `main`, **ahead 6**, staged `[]`, dirty ⇒ four commits since the QA verdict, all outside it.
- `project_read_file(".vitepress/config.mts", pattern="suggested|voice-conversation|chats-and-agents|users-and-security")` → 119 lines, line 43 `Suggested replies`, line 44 `Voice conversation` ⇒ both nav entries target untracked pages.
- `project_read_file("features/suggested-replies.md")` → 86 lines (new, unowned); `features/voice-conversation.md` → 185 lines (was 157 at 16:05Z).

**Classification vs the 16:05Z baseline:** 2 items **gone** (committed), 3 items **new**, 1 **grown**, 1 **unchanged**. No file was written; the only repository change from this shift is zero.

Moving to **Review** — the increment is complete, the claim is verifiable on `a8be6182`.

## QA verdict + the re-measure this card exists for — 2026-11-19 (shift 7, started 08:35Z)

**The current file list the approver needs** (`project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD)`, root-relative, measured this shift — supersedes the 19-hour-old list on `a8be6182`):

- **docs deliverable = 7 files, +101 / −0** (`.vitepress/config.mts` +2, `features/index.md` +2, `features/chats-and-agents.md` +4, `features/users-and-security.md` +2, `features/browser-use.md` +91, `features/suggested-replies.md` new/untracked, `features/voice-conversation.md` new/untracked).
- **Whole working tree = 57 files, +900 / −1966** at `base=HEAD`, of which the non-deliverable mass is control-plane noise: `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl` **+713** (was +565 three shifts ago, +460 before that — growing every shift) and `.codx/autonomy/state.json` +69/−50.
- `qa_plan(scope="all")` unfiltered still reports **189 changed files / 83 unmapped sources / suites: none** — the platform-root view, a different root from the docs deliverable. **Any "the diff is N files" claim must carry its root and prefix**, otherwise it is unreadable.

```
## Decision: block
- Scope: scope="all", base=HEAD; docs tree (7 files) and platform-root inventory (189 files) measured separately.
- Evidence: qa_review_changes(7 root-relative paths) -> block, high, changed_files 2, mapped 0/0;
            qa_review_changes(7 docs/-prefixed paths) -> block, high, changed_files 5, mapped 0/0;
            qa_plan -> suites: none, mapped_tests: 0, coverage: no report;
            qa_run_tests(auto) -> block, tests.no-suite, tests run 0; qa_coverage -> warn, coverage.unavailable, min 70.
- Findings: 1 — tests.no-suite (HIGH)
- Blocking item: there is no runnable suite in this project, so the re-measure can supply a file list but no verification.
- Owner: qa_automation / software_developer (suite on `09e338b9` / `3fb379ae`)
- Next command: qa_review_changes(scope="all", paths=[<7 root-relative docs paths>])
```

**New this shift, and it invalidates any diff count produced by the gate:** `qa_review_changes` matches **tracked** files only when the path carries the `docs/` prefix and **untracked** files only when it does not — `changed_files: 5` vs `2` on the same 7 files in the same minute, and `allow / changed_files: 0` when two untracked paths are given with the prefix. A re-measure that quotes `changed_files` from the gate alone would publish a number that is **structurally incomplete**; that is why the list above comes from `project_changes` and the verdict from `qa_review_changes`, quoted side by side.

**FAILING TEST IDS: none — zero tests executed** (`tests.no-suite`). Not green, not red: unverified.

**Note on this card's own purpose:** the file list *is* delivered above with its root, prefix and timestamp, so the approver no longer depends on a stale list. What remains blocked is verification, which this card cannot supply.

**Card state:** moving back to **Working** per standing order (verdict ≠ allow) with this gap.
